verdict.rationale: An official CLI is a fair question for a SaaS marketing platform with a public API, so the axis applies. The evidence documents APIs, SDKs (Python, PHP, Ruby, Node, mobile), a Postman collection, and an official MCP server, but nothing shows Klaviyo ships an official command-line tool. Those are adjacent building blocks or other features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
